adjusted_move.description: the weighted move over the adjustable share, after the threshold, as a fraction

adjustment.description: `certified_amount` times `adjusted_move`, rounded half up to the minor unit; negative on a fall

cap_amount.description: the cap in money, when `escalation_cap_scope` is `cumulative`

cap_used.description: the running total of adjustments on this contract, this claim included

certified_amount.description: the claim's certified amount the adjustment is made on

contract_terms_fact_id.description: the contract_terms fact whose clause was read

currency.description: the currency of every amount on this record (`certified_amount`, `adjustment`, `cap_amount`, `cap_used`), an ISO 4217 alpha-3 code. A record with no currency has no usable amount.

detail.description: a one-line explanation for display, naming the series, quarter or field concerned

direction.description: `rise` when the adjustment is owed to the contractor, `fall` when the principal may deduct it, `nil` when the threshold zeroes it

evidence_fact_ids.description: the facts the measurement read: the contract terms, the claim and every index observation

financial_period.description: the claim's period, as `progress_claim.financial_period` states it

formula_version.description: the version of the adjustment formula that computed this record

index_period.description: the index period this claim reads: its work quarter moved back by the clause's lag

lines.description: one entry per basket line: the series read, its weight, and the base and current values with the count of observations each was taken from

notice_due_on.description: the last day the adjustment can be claimed, from `escalation_notice_days`

project_entity_id.description: the project the contract is for

reason.description: why the claim is waiting or blocked; required unless `status` is `ready`

status.description: `ready`: the adjustment is computed. `waiting`: an index the clause needs is not yet published. `blocked`: something the tenant can fix is missing, named in `reason`.

weighted_move.description: the basket's weighted move, as a fraction (0.047 is 4.7%)
